# PerchTV 0.1.26

A film that ends, ends.

## WHAT CHANGED

- On Samsung televisions, a film the television never reported as finished could start again from the beginning, over and over. PerchTV now sees that the film has reached its end and stops, with "The stream ended".

## WHAT STAYS THE SAME

- Live TV still recovers on its own if the picture freezes, captions and Voice Guide on Samsung televisions, and up to eight phones.
